title: August and the Prom
author: Quentin Marchetti
blurb: Xanthe Ishikawa, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
